The memory entry replaced cleanly and freed some space (now 89% from 98%). The skill now documents both CPI-adjustment variants with the new Variant B (annual-average CPI deflation to a common base year) that this question exposed.

Summary of what I saved:
- Patched `officeqa-cpi-inflation-adjusted-dollar-amount` to add **Variant B**: signed difference of two years' figures each deflated to a common base year using annual-average CPI-U (`real_X = nom_X * CPI[base]/CPI[X]`), with the disambiguation cues ("for those years" / "in millions of YYYY dollars" → annual-avg deflation, vs "YoY rate for month MMM YYYY" → monthly base*(1+rate)).
- Updated the skill description and my memory note so future runs recognize there are two distinct CPI mechanics and don't misapply the YoY formula to a deflation question.

This was generalizable — the deflate-to-common-base-year pattern will recur for other Treasury Bulletin "in YYYY dollars" difference questions.
